items.t: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Halts Pelacarsen After Trial Miss As Ianalumab Data Impresses
items.sum: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) halted development of its cardiovascular drug pelacarsen after a late stage outcome trial failed to meet its goal. The decision affects Novartis' efforts in cardiovascular risk reduction, a major therapeutic area for large patient populations.
